modern: “The earth loves the shower”; and “the solemn ether loves”; and the universe loves to make whatever is about to be. I say then to the universe that I love as you love. And is this not also what is meant by saying that “this or that loves,” that is, tends, “to be produced”?
original: “The earth loves the shower;” and “the solemn ether loves;” and the universe loves to make whatever is about to be. I say then to the universe, that I love as thou lovest. And is not this too said that “this or that loves [is wont] to be produced?”
